status_source.note: Both layers recorded in claims/graph.json read OPEN (status_frozen_v2_2 and status_register_note). Read them there; they are not copied into this file so they cannot drift from the graph.

next_exact_action: Evaluate the lattice sums with `r` as an interval over the band. That yields G12-band enclosures, hence `Î(r)/r³ ≤ F(G12-band)` for the whole band — a finite computation per band, never a fitted exponent.
falsifier: A band enclosure whose width exceeds the claimed modulus.
inputs_note: Bound 2026-09-18 from engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json (records whose lane field is 'A1'). Binding an input records which bytes exist and where; it is not review, not replay and not endorsement, and it changes no status. Five manifest carriers serve lanes docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md has no section for (P0.1, P0.2, Theorem B) and are recorded there under NOT_IN_OPEN_PROBLEMS rather than forced into a lane here. CR-JETS (jets.py, from the lower campaign's DER-027b draft) was unbound from this lane on 2026-09-18: its Taylor jets are not the upper chart's 24-jet set, and the source never links the file to A1; it is now bound to lane H.

not_a_substitute.quote: RUNG2 (`r = 0.025`) and RUNG3 (`r = 0.035355`) certify those rungs only.

RUNG2/RUNG3 certify those rungs only. They do **not** discharge `OBL-D1-PROMOTE`, `OBL-H5-JETMOD`, ZBAND-hi or REMOTE-THRESHOLD. The displayed modulus is dense certified sampling plus an explicit fit.

repo_state_note: Interval-r lattice sums, reference-kernel band enclosures and exact Hermite-Gaussian derivative candidates now exist under research/bands/. They do not identify the program's complete 24-jet set, powers, geometry or band endpoints and do not produce the required actual-field 24-jet certificate. This corrects the earlier repository note saying no interval-r evaluator existed. repo_state remains scaffolded for the actual obligation, not a mathematical status.
does_not_establish: This lane file establishes nothing mathematical. It does not certify any band enclosure, does not discharge `OBL-H5-JETMOD` or `OBL-D1-PROMOTE`, and does not make the displayed modulus into a certified enclosure.
obligation: Certified interval bounds for the full 24-jet set — not just the displayed `c₂` — over the r-bands `[r_{k+1}, r_k]`, with lattice-tail constants re-certified **uniformly in the band** (the current LAT tail bound certifies at point separations only). Content: for each jet `J` and band `B`, `J(B)/r^{p_J} ∈` a certified interval.
